iOS 27 features I’m loving so far 📱✨

1. Resize your Lock Screen clock 
 I love that you can make the clock smaller and customise your Lock Screen exactly how you like it!

2. Bigger Home Screen widgets 
I LOVE this for Reminders! You can have your to do list right there on your Home Screen and tick things off as you go 🙌🏽 so handy for staying on top of everything!

3. Customise your Camera controls 📸
You can organise your Camera quick settings so the ones you actually use are easier to get to!

4. Combine emojis with Genmoji 🤯
 This one is so fun 😂 you can combine emojis together to create your own custom Genmoji!

5. Improved Clean Up 🪄
 Clean Up is even better for removing unwanted things from your photos, sooo handy when there’s something ruining an otherwise perfect photo!

6. Reframe your photos ✨
 I LOVE this one! You can change the framing of a photo after you’ve already taken it. So good when the original shot isn’t quite how you wanted it.

7. Extend photos for your wallpaper 
You can extend a photo so it fits your Lock Screen better instead of having to crop it awkwardly 😍

Which iOS 27 feature are you trying first?! 👀📱✨

Spring Cleaning 🌸✨ WASHING MACHINE DEEP CLEAN 🫧
Episode 4 of 20 

If you can’t remember the last time you deep cleaned your washing machine… this is your sign 😂🤢

Here’s what I did 👇🏽

🫧 Sprayed the rubber seal with Astonish Mould Blast, then used a small grout brush to get right into all the folds before wiping it clean.

🫧 Drained the water from the filter, removed it & gave it a really good clean.

🫧 Removed the detergent drawer and scrubbed that out too.

🫧 Added bicarb soda directly into the drum & vinegar into the fabric softener compartment.

🫧 Ran a drum clean cycle and once it was finished, left the door open to completely air dry!

It was definitely overdue but she’s looking & smelling brand new again 😍🙌🏽

Another one ticked off the Spring Cleaning list ✔️🌸
